mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC's own trajectory shows two consecutive weeks of improvement (-23.0 to -20.1), signaling a bottoming-out of the Omicron-driven mobility trough. failure_condition: If the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is lower than or equal to the prior 28-day mean despite the recent two-week uptick, the hypothesis is rejected.
